Cross-references checked in the published parts: 1965 (*Della part e della*), 2093 (*camearon*), 2340 and 2351

**Establishment: no error found.** 3183 *camear*: the first stroke of the m is broken (looks *caınear* at zoom 5), the
word is camear (as *camearon* v. 2093). 3186 *nadi*: the n is damaged below (looks *ŋadi*), nadi. 3134: the mark after
*tuerto* is small and low but comma-shaped; the pinned comma stands. 3183 *l[as]*: only *as* italic, as pinned.
3162 *y el bando*: so printed.

## Pass 1: units.json

1. 3127–3128 · n · error. The rubric was quoted *El Cid las da a Pedro Vermúdez y Martín Antolínez*; the print has
   *Pedro, Vermúdez* (zoom 4). Quoted as printed; the note says the comma is a slip (one man).
2. 3129–3131 · n · error. Pidal's note to 3130 quoted *se cantaban así*; the print has *asi* without accent (zoom 6;
   *había* in the same note does carry it). Fixed.
3. 3134–3136 · n · error. Note to 3135 quoted *debían*; the print has *debian* (zoom 3.5). Fixed.
4. 3145–3147 · n · error. Note to 3145 quoted *debían*; print *debian* (zoom 5). Fixed.
5. 3179b–3181 · n · error. The note said of 3179b "its number his own". Pidal prints no number by the line (margin seen
   at zoom 3: unnumbered, 3180 below); the b is ours, per conventions ("Unnumbered wholly italic lines take
   provisional letters"). Rewritten. (3197b *is* Pidal's own, PDF 329; that note is right.)
6. 3184–3185 · n · error. *sonrrisós* was parsed as "preterite of sonreír in its old strong form". It is the regular
   preterite of *sonrrisar* (cf. glossary *sonrrisar*, *sonrrisando*) + se cut to s. Fixed.
7. 3196–3197b · n · weak. Pidal's note to 3196 was given a closing quote mark the print lacks (line ends *bien.*);
   now quoted as printed, with a remark.
8. 3132–3133 · i · weak. "out of favour to my Çid" reads in English as "in disgrace". Now "for the favour I bear my
   Çid" (house *favour*, the lord's amor).
9. 3137–3139 · i · weak. "On both sides let there be peace today" dropped the 1st plural of *seamos*. Now "On this
   side and on that, let us be at peace today" (cf. 104-104c v. 2079 "On this side and on that").
10. 3182–3183 · i · weak. "and looked at … no one could have changed them" shifted tense and mood for no reason in
    English (*pueden* is present). Now "looks at them both; no one can change them for others".
11. 3188–3190 · i · weak. "for it is the better for its lord" is obscure and not what the note says. Now "for it has
    gained a better lord" (`l` and the note, which flags the reading, unchanged).
12. 3177–3179 · n · weak. *saca[n]* "with the Infantes as subject": the text does not say who draws the swords (the
    king now holds them). Now "the subject, 'they', is not named".
13. 3140–3142 · n · weak. *me so* explained as "a reflexive used with ser, 'I place myself'": overreads it. Now the
    reflexive often set beside *ser* in the old language, adding nothing to the sense.
14. 3160 (unit 3159–3160) · n · style. The text form in the note was spelled *García*; the print and `t` have
    *Garçía*. Fixed (i "Count García" kept).
15. 3153–3155 · n · style. *a guisa de varón* "as at v. 2575": it is v. 2576 (2575 has *a Colada e a Tizón*). Both
    references made exact.
16. 3177–3179 · i · style. "the whole court is lit with their gleam": embroidered. Now "the whole court gleams".
17. 3184–3185 · l · style. "rejoiced-to-him" → "rejoiced-itself-to-him", as 75-77 v. 1266 *alégrasle* "rejoices-itself-to-him".
18. 3129, 3135–3136, 3140, 3152, 3160, 3162, 3177, 3181, 3183 · l · style. Letter-level restorations bracketed in `l`
    (*wa[s]*, *co[u]nt(s)*, *Isidor[e]*, *th[e]m*, *th[ei]r*, *they-draw[]*, *whenc[e]*, *th[em]*), against the
    conventions ("brackets in `l` only for restored words or letters with an English counterpart") and 137a item 11.
    Now plain; the word-level [don Pero] and [or should-come occasion] keep their brackets.

Rulings on the drafter's points, no change:
- **1. camear** — confirmed (see Establishment); the rendering "change (for others)" is right.
- **2. nadi** — confirmed.
- **3. 3134 comma** — comma-shaped, low; kept; the note's caution is harmless.
- **4. [o viniere sazón]** — italic whole half-line confirmed; no footnote; reading flagged. Kept.
- **5. 3179b** — wholly italic confirmed, no footnote; numbering corrected (item 5).
- **6. [don Pero]** — both words italic; "Don Pero" in `i` is the house (115-117); identification sound. Kept.
- **7. bolviere** — 'throw into disorder' kept as a flagged reading (no Pidal note).
- **8. quitar me a el reyno** — split future, banishment reading, consistent with the glossary's *el reyno quitar*. Kept.
- **9. amor** — 3141/3157 "my favour" right for a lord/father-in-law; 3147 *por mi amor* "out of love for me" right
  (the king's act for the Çid's sake). 3132 i reworded (item 8).
- **10. ivan trayendo** — Pidal's 'tratando' followed. Right.
- **11. saca[n]** — n italic confirmed; subject note softened (item 12).
- **12. mejora en señor** — kept as a flagged reading; `i` clarified (item 11).
- **13. 3194 opening “** — confirmed on the print; the note is accurate.
- **14. Remont Verenguel / Barcelona** — as in 56-59. Kept.
- **15. y el bando** — confirmed.
- **Footnote quotations** — apart from items 1–4 and 7, exact (inner single quotes converted to double, small-caps
  *xvi* given as XVI, Pidal's italics such as *condes*, *El conde don Ramón* not marked, as in earlier parts).
  3135 *don Anric* (one r) is right as quoted.

Refused:
- Removing the 3134 comma discussion from the note — it is accurate and short.
- Changing 3155–3158 *quando* "since" to "when" in `i` — the note explains the causal force; defensible.
- `l` "take to Colada" (3194) and "to Colada and to Tizón" (3153) — literal personal *a*, explained in the notes; kept
  though 124-125 drops the *to* in `l`.

## Pass 2: gloss.json

All 49 novel forms have entries; no extra entries. The seven `__broaden__` values each start with the old entry whole +
" · " (checked by script); one broaden added.

1. perderá · error. "future 3rd sg., syncopated": perderá is not syncopated. Removed.
2. trayendo · error. "bringing along, carrying on … the exact sense is uncertain (?)": ignored Pidal's 'tratando'
   (which units.json follows). Now 'treating, discussing', Pidal quoted, = tratando.
3. maçanas · error. "= manzanas, not used for pommel now": false (manzana 'pomo de la espada' is current
   dictionary Spanish). Aside removed; Pidal 'pomo' added.
4. tornos · error. "the vowel lost before the s": it is the e of se that is lost (tornó + s(e)); also printed without
   the accent. Fixed.
5. nómbrel · error. "nombre with its -e dropped before the enclitic le": the noun is whole; it is le that is cut to l,
   the object of llamó leaning on the noun. Fixed.
6. finca · error. "modern fincar is 'to settle on land'" invented; and the sense missed Pidal's 'acaba la demanda'.
   Rewritten.
7. boz · weak. "the legal sense is our reading (?)": Pidal gives it ('acaba la demanda'). Now cited.
8. mejora · weak. 'grows better … in a (good) lord' disagreed with units.json; now 'it gains, is bettered … gains a
   better lord', flagged as a reading.
9. coládal · style. Spanish "el nombre" inside the English gloss; reworded, accent explained.
10. curiedes · weak. "Latin curare" (unsupported etymology) dropped; Pidal 'cuidéis' cited; 'you may guard'.
11. bolviere · style. Aligned with units ("throw into disorder, disturb"), "(?)" replaced by "a reading".
12. levó · style. The modern levar/llevar aside dropped; levarse en pie given.
13. escoger · weak. "single out" → "pick out, find", with Pidal 'para hallar el derecho', as units.json.
14. arriazes · style. 'cross-guard' (as units.json), Pidal 'gavilán' cited; "= arriaces".
15. coñoscedores · style. "one form for both genders" (unattested in this line) dropped; Pidal 'entendidos' cited.
16. __broaden__ razón · weak. "acuerdan la razón 'they agree on their plea'" → 'they agree on their answer', Pidal
    'convienen la respuesta', as units.json.
17. __broaden__ tomó · weak. "se ethic" misnames it; now tomarse a 'take hold of' (pronominal), as the note.
18. __broaden__ quitar · style. "(?)" and "tendrá que dejar" tidied; the banishment reading stated as in units.json.
19. __broaden__ a · added (weak). The known entry *a* lacked the split-future ending (= ha) used twice here (quitar me
    a, partir se a): broadened, old entry whole + " · ".

Checked and right: reçiba, tenido, sabémoslo, alcaldes, vando, juro, toviere, dessa, demande, responden, fiziestes,
demando, sabredes (syncopated, right), sacaron, diles, ondrassen, sirviessen, perdieron, denme, atorgan, demanda,
abendremos, tornaron, negar, dárgelas, pusiéronlas, relumbra, camear, alegrósle (alegró + se + le, = se le alegró),
alçava, tendió, prendetla, ganéla, acaeçiere; broadens se, partir, que.
Refused: broadening *connosçe* ('recognizes' fits "bien las connosçe"); broadening *tiene* further.
